cards.title: Again and again
cards.body: Present simple is for things you do **again and again**, and things that are **true every time**.
points: Again and again: **I work in a shop. She gets up at seven.**
True every time: **Dogs like meat. The shop opens at nine.**

cards.title: Form
cards.body: Use the **base verb** (the verb with nothing added: *work*). For **he / she / it**, add **-s**.
points: **I work. You work. We work. They work.**

cards.title: One Czech tense, two English
cards.body: Czech has one present tense for *now* and for *every day*: *pracuju* is both. English has two. Present simple is the *every day* one.
points: **I work in a shop.** = my job, every day
For *right now* there is another form. It comes later.

cards.title: Common mistakes
cards.body: Three things go wrong with one small ending.
points: No **-s** with he / she / it: *She work in a shop* → **She works in a shop**
*be* + verb: *I am work in Prague* → **I work in Prague**
**-s** in the wrong place: *I works* → **I work**
